Companion app for the SAP Build Apps product, allowing you to view and interact with your projects on an iOS device. Also supports SAP AppGyver Classic and AppGyver Community Edition.

After logging in, you can open one of your projects from the list. As you make changes in the web tool, the device will update to show your work in real time, ideal for quick prototyping and testing.
